vars.goal: the main scene res://main.tscn (root Main, ui/Main.cs) holds the hive (game/game.tscn) as its child Game; a fourth producer, the Moon Lily (moon_lily: costs 20,000, grows by 1.13, makes 220 a second); a third buy mode, Buy max, with Economy.MaxAffordable(id) and Economy.BuyMax(id); upgrades in data/upgrades.json ({ id, name, target: a producer id, "tap" or "all", multiplier, cost, needs: how many of the target must be owned }), bought with Economy.BuyUpgrade(id), shown on a second page that the bar at the bottom of the hive switches to (Safe/Column/Bar/ProducersTab and UpgradesTab, pages Safe/Column/ProducerPage and UpgradePage, one row per upgrade named after its id in PascalCase plus Row, such as WarmHandsRow, shown once its target is owned often enough); the dawn: Economy.DawnGain() is the square root of the glow earned since the last dawn divided by 1,000,000, rounded down, Economy.Dawn() (when the gain is at least 1) adds it to Embers, counts Dawns and empties Glow, producers (Economy.Owned) and upgrades, each ember adds 10% to all production, and Safe/Column/Bar/DawnButton opens a DawnPanel whose Box/ConfirmButton greets the dawn and Box/CancelButton closes it, with the embers shown in Safe/Column/Top/EmbersLabel as "Embers: N (+P% glow)"; a save by a SaveStore class in user://save.json, with Main writing the economy (Economy.ToDict() and Economy.FromDict(catalog, data), the embers and dawns kept in its "prestige") with the time it was saved; on start Main pays the time since the save at the saved rate, at most 8 hours (28,800 seconds), nothing for a clock set back, and shows it in a WelcomePanel; Main reads the clock through its public field clock (a Func<double> returning Unix seconds) and saves to its public field save_path, both set before it enters the tree, and saves with save_now(), with the hive as its property game; a settings screen (Safe/Column/Bar/SettingsButton adds a child of Main named Settings with a volume slider and Safe/Box/BackButton back to the hive); and a data.json for the kit's data runner
